title: Chapter 419: The City Lord'S Mansion'S Foundation
content:
Chapter 419: The City Lord'S Mansion'S Foundation

At this time, in the deserted city of Chaos Realm.

Because Lu Daosheng was not around, Lu Xue warmly welcomed the ancestors of the three clans and talked about the past.

In response to this, Lu Xue was like a good girl, silently listening to the three old seniors talking big, and nodding from time to time to agree.

"Xiaoxue, you are not young anymore. When will you bring a man back to see you?"

As he was talking, the ancestor of the Li family suddenly said this.

Judging from Lu Xue's age now, she can be said to be a ancestral figure.

However, in the eyes of the three old men in front of him, he was still a child.

When Lu Xue heard what the ancestor of the Li family said, he was slightly stunned. He didn't know what to say, so he could only smile embarrassedly.

"Okay, okay, this is Xiaoxue's own business. The city lord is not in a hurry, you are anxious first."

The ancestor of the Zhang family on the side directly said.

This made Lu Xue look at the Zhang family ancestor with gratitude.

The ancestor of the Liu family laughed.

In this way, the four of them were having fun and chatted until evening. The three ancestors then returned to their homes. Before leaving, Lu Xue took out the jasmine tea left by Daosheng inland in the city lord's mansion and gave it to them.

Before leaving, the three ancestors kept saying Lu Xue's goodness, and if there were any difficulties in the city lord's mansion, just open your mouth or something.

Looking at the backs of the three of them gradually faded away, Lu Xue stopped for a long time before retracting her gaze and turning back to the city lord's mansion.

Papa!

Two crisp slaps sounded.

The next moment, an illusory figure appeared in front of Lu Xue.

The figure had no breath on his body and could not feel it at all.

"Root organization, may you be mobilized?"

Lu Xue looked at the phantom in front of her and then asked.

"It's absolutely fine."

The phantom answered truthfully.

When Lu Xue heard this, she nodded, "That's good."

"Report the important things that have happened in the Desert City and the Chaos Realm over the years."

"Yes, Miss Lu Xue."

This person is also affiliated with Gen, and is An Xing's personal guard. He only obeys An Xing, Lu Daosheng and Lu Xue.

Like the man who was the masked cat during the day, although he was the nominal leader of the root organization, he had no right to mobilize this person.

Lu Xue believes that there must be such existences in the wild guards.

So although the two current leader and the leader of the Huangwei were eliminated, Lu Xue was not worried that these two huge organizations would not be able to operate.

What has happened over the years is quite different. Lu Xue listened with the key points and listened for three days and three nights.

"Miss Lu Xue, my subordinates have completed their report."

Suddenly, Lu Xue opened her bright eyes and looked at the person in front of her.

"Bring Wu Hui over to see me."

Lu Xue opened her red lips lightly, and she couldn't hear any emotion.

"Affect the order."

The phantom turned into a darkness and escaped into the shadow.

Just as the shadow left, the space in front of Lu Xue trembled, and a figure fell in front of Lu Xue in a slightly embarrassed manner.

"Who?!"

Lu Xue was slightly shocked, and her middle finger and index finger merged together, turning into an extremely sharp sword, pointing directly at the person in front of her.

The surrounding space began to tremble wildly.

Several black shadows and a powerful sense of oppression came towards this place.

The entire city lord's mansion began to shake.

Countless terrifying spiritual senses in the dark swept towards this place, almost crushing the space here.

At this moment, the foundation of the city lord's mansion finally revealed the tip of his iceberg.

Even if Lu Daosheng is not here, he will not think of any attempt to get involved in the deserted city.

Seeing that there were countless strong men coming towards this place, the man who fell in front of Lu Xue finally came back to his senses, quickly got up, and shouted to Lu Xue: "You are your own people, you are your own people!"

Lu Xue frowned slightly, and when she saw the person in front of her, a hint of surprise appeared in her eyes.

"Hey, it's you, um, what's the matter?"

"It is the sky, and it is the sky."

Shi Tianzhi looked awkward and there was still a little panic in his eyes. God knew how much pressure he was just now. He felt that in no time, the terrifying pressure around him would shatter his soul.

As Lu Xue recognized Shi Tianzhi, the pressure around him also decreased sharply. Shi Tianzhi then breathed a sigh of relief, and his pale face began to gradually calm down.

"Ao, I remember you. My father summoned you."

While Lu Xue said, she looked at Shi Tianzhi in front of her curiously. Although she remembered Shi Tianzhi, she didn't understand why this guy suddenly appeared here.

What is this place? It is the strictest place in the entire deserted city.

But now, Shi Tianzhi suddenly appeared here, and no strong man could sense it.

At the same time, the strong men gathered outside the courtyard. They all knelt down in the direction of Lu Xue, looking panicked, "We are not well-defended, please ask Miss Lu Xue to punish me!"

An old man skipped the guards and came straight to Lu Xue.

Seeing the visitor, Lu Xue chuckled and said, "Old Jiang, why did you even be alarmed?"

Mr. Jiang, named Jiang Yuan, is the old housekeeper of the Lord of the Huangcheng City Mansion. In Lu Xue's heart, Jiang Yuan is like his grandfather, and she is full of respect.

As the steward of the Lord of the Huangcheng City Mansion, his strength is naturally not enough.

Mr. Jiang looked at Lu Xue and smiled lovingly, "If something happens to you, I will have no face to face the city lord, old man."

At this time, countless spiritual senses were still paying attention to the here, and even Lu Xue did not know the identity of those existences.

Dad, you're hiding it quite deep.

Lu Xue sighed in her heart and was also a little happy.

"Miss Lu?"

At this moment, Shi Tianzhi suddenly looked at Lu Xue carefully and shouted.

"Um?"

Lu Xue came back to her senses and looked at Shi Tianzhi again. She just looked at Shi Tianzhi without saying anything.

But Shi Tianzhi understood Lu Xue's meaning and immediately explained why he suddenly appeared here.

"It's the Lord of the City, your father sent me here."

“He also brought me a message.”

When Lu Xue heard Shi Tianzhi's words, he looked surprised.

Fearing that Lu Xue and others would not believe it, Shi Tianzhi even posted the words Lu Daosheng into his mind again.

Soon, Lu Daosheng's voice sounded from the field.

"You go to the Chaos Realm and tell everyone that the land of the gods will invade the Chaos Realm soon."

When everyone present heard Lu Daosheng's voice, they trembled all over and their bodies were tense. That was caused by excitement.

Even Jiang Yuan's eyes were a little wet.

"Dad."

Lu Xue's eyes flashed with longing and murmured.

After a moment of silence, Lu Xue quickly digested this longing.

He waved his hand to everyone, "Let's retreat first."

"Yes, Miss Lu Xue!"
